author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be a serial killer on Reddit finally found and taken care of by law enforcement. A mystery post came out last December and while initially innocuous seems to have led to the discovery of a monster behind a harrowing killing spree. How did this happen? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: The Reddit Serial Killer Has Been Caught...
